end.summary:
Estimated collections using handfuls, groups, and extra objects as guides.
Correctly combined 5 groups of 10 and 2 extra seeds to make 52.
Checked whether guesses were close to or far from the actual number.
Repeatedly counted groups as individual objects instead of counting all objects in the groups; this was not corrected by the last seen turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised estimating collections, grouping in 10s, and comparing guesses with the actual number. Ananya used the method of finding groups of 10 plus extras to explain 52 and identified 45 as closer than 90. They sometimes counted the number of groups as the total number of objects, and this mix-up was still present at the last example. At home, make small groups of 10 buttons or pencils and ask, “How many altogether, including the extras?”
